cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Join my request to keep the pottery room open late. One name is a personal request; we need a properly represented proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly why I need you. An evening-class petition only proves the evening class wants longer hours. Put your class beside your name, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The morning class wants weekend access.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then change the heading to 'Extended access' and bring their representative. One proposal, please; don't split our support into two little complaints.

reason: Make A professional categorisation and drafting corrections shape the coalition rather than merely decorate an inherited request.
